scope: BCM70015 FHD H.264 card scaling, host field assembly and GStreamer scalerbob; not VA Bob or hardware deinterlacing

direct_field_capture.comparison_scope: unscaled bytes are the historical 2026-10-15 capture, not a new RX control or PCIe wire measurement

scaled_weave_oracle.comparison: all active YUY2 bytes equal independently captured fields joined by input token, sorted by source packet PTS

bob_benchmark.fixture: existing kodi-h264-1080i25-30s.mkv, 750 H.264 MBAFF pictures, stream-level TFF not uniform-parity acceptance
bob_benchmark.pipeline: filesrc ! matroskademux ! h264parse ! identity sync=PACED ! crystalhddec scale-width=WIDTH ! deinterlace method=scalerbob fields=all ! appsink sync=false drop=false
bob_benchmark.cpu_timer: set_state(PLAYING)-to-EOS, includes state-change/device startup and DIL workers; construction/close excluded
bob_benchmark.latency: decoder sink AU arrival to appsink output, joined by PTS; two Bob outputs per AU

source_live_paced.fixture: bob_benchmark.fixture, two consecutive repetitions with PTS +30 seconds
source_live_paced.pipeline: appsrc ! bounded queue ! crystalhddec ! deinterlace method=scalerbob fields=all ! appsink sync=false
source_live_paced.source_clock: 25 Hz decode ordinal; independent packet PTS match and 748-packet affine DTS suffix, origin -59000000 ns; all 750 original Gst DTSNONE values per repetition preserved
source_live_paced.loop_boundary: real IDR/SPS/PPS; no EOS NAL, extra segment, DISCONT, flush or reopen
source_live_paced.pilot_scope: predeclared bounded-source/output/backlog/age checks, not a release or physical-display gate
source_live_paced.cpu_timer: process CPU from set_state(PLAYING) through 60-second boundary, including device startup; CPU preload, construction, EOS tail and close excluded
source_live_paced.startup_scope: warmup retained; startup decoder inflight exceeds the steady-window value of six
source_live_paced.final_keysets_pts_eos_null_close: PASS both runs; pre-EOS receipt durable before EOS request

clocked_sink_control.source_and_cpu_scope: source_live_paced; unchanged source PTS and decode-ordinal clock, not a fabricated Gst DTS clock
clocked_sink_control.control: private GstPipeline.set_latency automatic versus 350 ms experiment, not a production option or decoder fix
clocked_sink_control.jitter: sample Gst clock minus actual base time, segment running time and observed LATENCY event; feeder-relative lateness is a separate metric
clocked_sink_control.interval_scope: decoder-output to preclock includes Bob and release-queue residence; preclock to callback includes BaseSink scheduling and callback overhead, not exclusive CPU or card time
clocked_sink_control.final_keysets_pts_eos_null_close: PASS both runs; decoder-output intervals remain comparable, not faster decoding or physical scanout

source_live_saturation.source: same closed-IDR fixture repeated without media-clock pacing; at most one enqueue per iteration with up to 1 ms bus polling
source_live_saturation.source_timestamps: original PTS plus 30 seconds per repetition; Gst DTSNONE preserved; no extra segment, DISCONT, flush or reopen
source_live_saturation.cpu_timer: process CPU from set_state(PLAYING) through 60-second boundary, including startup; preload, construction, tail and close excluded
source_live_saturation.steady_cpu_scope: first-to-last resource samples inside each window, approximately 14 seconds; RSS is current resident memory, separate from process peak

runs.included_observation: fresh uncontended confirmation of affected scaled cell only

source_live_saturation.final_identity: exact unique accepted AU/decoder-input keysets and two fields per AU, including partial decode-order GOP; not a fabricated contiguous final PTS range

excluded_observation.disposition: original raw capture retained unchanged and excluded from comparison; independent reviewer CPU parsing creates potential contention, exact overlap unknown; only this cell was purposefully confirmed

source_live_saturation.measurement_limit: observed 60-second host pipeline saturation, not maximum card throughput, realtime age, physical cadence or endurance

qualification.original_collector_fail: 50 exact-pixel callbacks and EOS succeeded, then Python caps-object repr comparison failed; retained FAIL, device-free old RED/content-string GREEN followed by fresh PASS without production changes
qualification.source_live_clock_saturation_raw_review: APPROVE scoped keysets, timestamps, pre-EOS separation and resource boundaries; potentially contended original scaled saturation excluded

source_live_clock_saturation_debug_warn_.scope: plugin-scanner startup warnings, distinct from the four shared metadata rows and bus warnings

qualification.cpu_preload_history: initial CPU-only missing-DTS refusal retained, not a driver failure; independent affine DTS suffix qualifies decode-ordinal scheduling without fabricating buffer DTS

not_measured: hardware Bob, temporal DI or physical source leasing
